name: Davco Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer
paste:
DAVCO® SANITIZED TILE & GROUT SEALER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer, February 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/davco-sanitized-tilegroutsealer.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. A solvent-based sealer that helps protect against stains, soiling, discolouration and efflorescence
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Suitable for interior and exterior applications.
    - Commercial and domestic walls and floor grout joints.
    - Only suitable for cement-based grouts.
    - Can also be used over most unglazed porous ceramic tiles.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (February 2025, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Clear solution which cures to an invisible, water repellent coating
    - Easy to apply
    - Provides good protection from stains
    - Prevents Efflorescence
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: Clear liquid
    - Specific gravity: 1.0 kg/L
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Application Time: Allow Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer to dry for 24 hours prior to returning to service
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 500ml Metal can
    - Shelf life: 12 Months from date of manufacture
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions off ground out of direct sunlight

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - Ensure grout joints and tile surfaces are thoroughly dry, clean, free from dirt, dust, grease, oil, wax and other contaminants.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: Approximately 6-10m2/L (depending upon surface porosity and site conditions)
4.3 Application. 1. Apply using a sponge, brush or spray gun. 2. Allow 5-10 minutes for the sealer to penetrate the surface, then wipe off excess with a damp sponge. 3. Allow the sealer to cure for 24 hours prior to returning the area to service.
    - Note: If only sealing grout joints of porous ceramic or terracotta tiles, ensure clean up method is pre-tested. It may be necessary to mask the joints
4.4 Cleaning of tools. Excess Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer and tools can be cleaned up with Mineral Turpentine while the product is still wet / prior to drying.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
    - Do not flood the floor with Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer. Apply only in small sections and clean up the area before moving on
    - Do not allow excess sealer to dry on the surface of the tiles as it will leave a white residue
    - For other uses not mentioned in these instructions, please contact Sika Australia

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (February 2025, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer, February 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/davco-sanitized-tilegroutsealer.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer, version 12/09/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/Sanitized%20Tile%20&%20Grout%20Sealer.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer, version 17/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sds-davco-sanitizedtilegroutsealer.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Various Semi-Finished, version 17/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sds-various-semi-finished.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
